Description: Boolean variable dictating whether a grid cell's waterbodies are estuaries (instead of freshwaters). 0 represents false, 1 represents true. This parameter is only required if the config option `include_estuary` is `.true.`, otherwise the model assumes there are no estuaries
Potential source: Could be deduced from land use maps, such as [CORINE Land Cover](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/corine-land-cover)

Required or optional: Optional, defaults to calculation based on grid size
Description: Meandering factor to account for rivers not being straight lines. If not present, meandering factor is estimated from the grid cell size, according to $f_m = 1.024 - 0.077 * \ln (200 / (dx + dy))$ {cite:p}`fekete_2001`.
Potential source: Could be deduced from river network vectors, such as [OS Open Rivers](https://www.ordnancesurvey.co.uk/products/os-open-rivers)

Description: Average minimum or maximum water temperature across the year. Calculates daily water temperature timeseries using a cosine curve based on these values.

Day of the year on which the minimum water temperature usually occurs, as an integer. Defaults to 32, which represents the first day of February. Used along with min/max water temperature to calculate water temperature timeseries.
Shear rate at the water-sediment interface, used for calculating resuspension. Defaults to 10 /s {cite}`arvidsson_2011`.

Required or optional: Required if model domain has estuary
Description: The M2 component of the tidal harmonics.
Potential source: Estuary authorities such as the Thames Port Authority

Required or optional: Required if model domain has estuary
Description: The S2 component of the tidal harmonics.
Potential source: Estuary authorities such as the Thames Port Authority

Required or optional: Required if model domain has estuary
Description: Position of the estuary mouth as (x, y) coordinates. Used to calculute upstream estuary dimensions based on exponential regression dependent on distance to estuary mouth.
Potential source: Estuary authorities such as the Thames Port Authority

Required or optional: Required if model domain has estuary
Description: Parameters `a` and `b` controlling the dependence of the estuary mean depth or width on distance to the mouth. For example, parameters `estuary_width_expa` and `estuary_width_expb` are used to calculate the width of the estuary upstream by a distance of `d` by the relation `width = estuary_width_expa * exp(-estuary_width_expb * d)`.
Potential source: Could be calibrated from vector map data showing width of rivers, or estuary monitoring data with depths
